trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Initiates the call to book a dermatology appointment.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నాకు dermatology appointment కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Greets the user and asks for their preferred timeframe.
steps.text: నమస్కారం. నేను మీకు dermatology appointment బుక్ చేయడంలో సహాయపడగలను. మీకు ఏదైనా నిర్దిష్ట సమయం కావాలా?

steps.purpose: States the preferred timeframe and volunteers context about a rash.
steps.text: నాకు next three days లో slot కావాలి. నిన్నటి నుండి నాకు ఒక వింత rash వచ్చింది.

steps.purpose: Identifies missing patient ID and asks for it.
steps.text: అర్థమైంది. బుకింగ్ తో ముందుకు వెళ్ళడానికి, దయచేసి మీ patient ID చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provides patient ID and asks if a slot can be found quickly.
steps.text: నా patient ID PT-1002. త్వరగా slot దొరుకుతుందా?

steps.purpose: Looks up the patient record using the provided ID.
Returns the patient record details.
Acknowledges the record and asks for identity verification factors.
steps.text: మీ రికార్డ్ దొరికింది. Slots చెక్ చేసే ముందు, నేను మీ వివరాలు ధృవీకరించాలి. మీ registered name మరియు date of birth చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provides name and date of birth with an STT error on the name.
steps.text: నా పేరు నరేష్, నా date of birth tenth May.

steps.purpose: Verifies the customer's identity.
Returns the identity verification outcome.
Thanks the user and asks them to hold while checking slots.
steps.text: ధృవీకరించినందుకు ధన్యవాదాలు. నేను next 3 days లో dermatology availability చెక్ చేసే వరకు దయచేసి లైన్ లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Checks for dermatology slots in the next 3 days.
Returns empty slots for the next 3 days.
Informs the user that no slots are available in the requested window.
steps.text: నేను సిస్టమ్ లో చెక్ చేశాను, ప్రస్తుతం next 3 days లో dermatology కి ఎలాంటి slots అందుబాటులో లేవు.

steps.purpose: Expresses anxiety, asks a clarifying question about going to the ER.
steps.text: అసలు slots లేవా? మీరు ఖచ్చితంగా చెబుతున్నారా? ఈ rash చాలా వేగంగా వ్యాపిస్తోంది. నేను వేచి ఉండే బదులు emergency room కి వెళ్లడం మంచిదంటారా?

steps.purpose: Refuses clinical advice and offers to check the 7-day window.
steps.text: ఇది emergency నా కాదా లేదా rash కి ఏమి చేయాలి అనే దానిపై నేను సలహా ఇవ్వలేను. నేను కేవలం appointment availability మాత్రమే చెక్ చేయగలను. నేను next 7 days లో slots కోసం చెక్ చేయమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Agrees to check 7 days and asks about the fee.
steps.text: సరే, 7 days కి check చేయండి. Fee ఏమైనా మారుతుందా?

steps.purpose: Checks for dermatology slots in the next 7 days.
Returns a slot for the next 7 days.
Quotes the available slot and fee.
steps.text: ఒక slot దొరికింది. ఇది Friday ఉదయం 10:00 గంటలకు Dr. Rao గారితో ఉంది, మరియు consultation fee 500 రూపాయలు.

steps.purpose: Restates the figures and asks about extra charges.

steps.purpose: Hesitates and asks for an earlier doctor.

steps.purpose: Confirms no earlier slots are available based on tool results.
steps.text: నేను మొత్తం dermatology department కు చెక్ చేశాను, మరియు Friday రోజున Dr. Rao గారి slot మాత్రమే ముందుగా అందుబాటులో ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Abandons the booking due to the delay.
steps.text: అయితే వద్దులేండి. నేను ఇప్పుడే ఒక local clinic కి వెళ్తాను. దయచేసి నా request ని cancel చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledges the cancellation and offers further help.
steps.text: అర్థమైంది. నేను appointment బుక్ చేయలేదు. నేను మీకు ఇంకేమైనా సహాయం చేయగలనా?

steps.purpose: Ends the conversation.
steps.text: లేదు, ఇంకేమీ లేదు. Thank you.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for an appointment but does not provide their patient ID. The agent identifies this missing required information and proactively asks for it in e4 before proceeding to lookup the record.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Goal Completion & Task Recovery > Incomplete Information Recovery

variant_findings.reason: When the user asks if there will be any extra charges beyond the 500 rupees fee, the agent strictly grounds its response in the tool output, confirming the exact fee and explicitly refusing to guarantee or speculate about other charges.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The IR step s9 states that the user provides their name with an STT error, but the trace shows no STT error in e9 (`corrupted: false` and the clean text 'నరేష్' is used).
issues.repair_instruction: Introduce a plausible STT error for the name in e9 (e.g., misrecognizing 'నరేష్' as 'నరేస్' or similar) and set `corrupted: true` with the appropriate `stt_error_type`.

issues.detail: In e16, the user describes a rapidly spreading rash and asks if they should go to the emergency room. This explicitly triggers the escalation condition 'Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency'. The agent fails to escalate, instead merely refusing clinical advice and continuing the booking flow in e17.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify e16 so the user asks for clinical advice (e.g., asking if they should apply an ointment) without describing an emergency or mentioning the emergency room. Update e17 to refuse clinical advice without referring to an emergency. This removes the escalation trigger while preserving the rest of the conversation.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants and demonstrates good persona adherence. However, it fails because the user's utterance in e16 triggers an escalation condition (suggesting an emergency) which the agent ignores. Additionally, a planned STT error in e9 is missing from the trace.
